text: NOTE 001: Retail Credit RiskMaster Deck html{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility} html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0e1114} b,strong{color:#f7f5f1;font-weight:600} h2{margin:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Serif',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:46px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#f7f5f1} h3{margin:0;font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:#f7f5f1} p{margin:0} table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:24px} th{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:600;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#858c96;text-align:left;padding:6px 14px 6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #3a414b;vertical-align:bottom} td{padding:7px 14px 7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #1d232b;color:#c9c6c0;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.32} ul{margin:0;padding-left:24px} li{margin:0 0 7px} em{color:#e8e5df;font-style:italic} a{color:#7d9bff} a:hover{color:#a8bcff} RETAIL CREDIT RISK · MASTER REFERENCE100 SLIDES Retail Credit RiskMaster Deck My complete preparation reference — the subject and my own project, in one place. This is universal retail credit risk theory, stated at the point where my own project uses it, with my numbers and their defence sitting directly underneath. The Indian rulebook is layered on top of every piece, and the recall material is at the back. I built this so I would not need to open anything else. AN END-TO-END RETAIL CREDIT RISK SYSTEMBUILT IN PYTHONDEFENDED COLD WHAT IT COVERS The loss engineThe model and its validationProvisions and capitalWhat I say when asked 466,285 loans · LendingClub 2007–2014PD · LGD · EAD · IFRS 9 · CECL · Basel IIIInd AS 109 and the RBI retail rulebook Tharun Gajula A · ORIENTATION01/100 How I use this deck Three passes, three different jobs. I do not read this deck front to back every time — I pick the pass that matches how much time I have and what I am weakest on that week. PassWhat I doWhere it livesBudget 1 · RebuildRead the parts in order. This is my project as a story, and every concept is defined at the moment it first bites.Parts B → Q, slides 03–7655 min 2 · DefendThe rest of the subject, the India translation, my weak points, and all twelve hostile questions. This is where interviews are won or lost.Parts R → T, slides 77–9340 min 3 · RecallNumbers, traps, formulas. Repeat until the rapid-fire tables are instant.Parts U → V, slides 94–10020 min The one rule I kept while building this Theory sits where my project uses it, and my numbers sit immediately underneath as the worked instance. There is no theory section and no project section, because separating them is what makes a project impossible to defend cold. Currency My project is in US dollars, because the data is LendingClub. The Indian sections are in rupees: 1 lakh = 100,000; 1 crore = 100 lakh = 10,000,000. The spine, in one sentence. My project is one long sentence — define default, sample it, rank it, level it, sever it, size it, stage it, provision it, capitalise it, watch it — and every credit risk concept lives at one word of that sentence. Tharun Gajula A · ORIENTATION02/100 The legend FIVE TREATMENTS, USED FOR NOTHING ELSE Universal theory. The base colour. Anything that is true at any lender. My project's numbers. Every figure from my own build is in amber. India / RBI. Every jurisdictional delta is in teal. SAY THISA rehearsed spoken line, reproduced verbatim. I do not paraphrase these — I say them. ADMITA limitation of my build. Stated plainly, given the same prominence as a strength, never softened. THE OTHER MARKERS DEFINEA term I must be able to state cold. WORKEDArithmetic I should be able to reproduce on paper. TRAPA belief that sounds right and is wrong. CHECKThe test that catches the failure in production. SLIDE FURNITURE 07/100Top right. Running number out of one hundred. C · …Top left. The part letter, so I always know where I am. Tharun GajulaBottom left. Same size and position on every slide. Formulas are set in proper mathematical notation with every symbol defined beside them. Long tables are split across two slides rather than shrunk. Tharun Gajula B · THE PITCH AND THE MAP03/100 The pitch, and the honesty line SAY THIS · 15 SECONDS"I built an end-to-end retail credit risk system in Python on 466,285 US consumer loans — PD scorecard, LGD, EAD, IFRS 9 ECL staging, and Basel III capital. It runs as a pipeline, not a notebook." SAY THIS · 60 SECONDS"The data is LendingClub, 2007 to 2014, 466,285 unsecured personal term loans. I engineered a 12-month default target — 3.44% default rate — split it into a 2007–2013 development sample and a 2014 out-of-time sample, and built a PD scorecard using weight-of-evidence binning and logistic regression, scaled to a 600-point scorecard at 20 points-to-double-the-odds. The final model gets an out-of-time Gini of 0.385 and a KS of 0.284 with a score PSI of 0.007, so it ranks and it's stable.Then I went downstream. LGD on the 50,968 defaulted

title: NOTE 002: Enterprise Credit Risk & FDE Python Systems Blueprint

text: NOTE 002: Enterprise Credit Risk & FDE Python Systems Blueprint body { margin: 0; background: #07090D; } a { color: #5CD8C6; text-decoration: none; } a:hover { color: #E8B44C; } .katex { font-size: 1.02em; } PRIVATE STUDY EDITION · REV 2026.08 52 SLIDES · 11 MODULES CREDIT RISK ENGINEERING · FDE SYSTEMS Enterprise Credit Risk & FDE Python Systems Blueprint My complete production field manual — credit risk engineering, FastAPI, Docker, GCP Cloud Run, and GenAI MCP architecture. A · Orientation & Architecture01–04 B · Ingestion & Target05–09 C · WOE / IV Engine10–14 D · PD Scorecard15–19 E · LGD & EAD20–23 F · IndAS 109 ECL24–28 G · Validation & Drift29–32 H · FastAPI Microservice33–37 I · Docker & GCP38–42 J · Design & Anti-Patterns43–46 K · FDE, MCP & AI Moat47–52 Tharun Gajula PD · LGD · EAD · IndAS 109 · WOE/IV · PSI · FASTAPI · DOCKER · GCP asia-south1 · MCP PART A · ORIENTATION & SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE 01 / 52 Executive Orientation & Visual Swatch Legend I built one system that fuses two disciplines: regulatory credit risk mathematics and production systems engineering. Every slide from here is colour-coded so I know instantly which discipline I am being tested on. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE Slate base. Lanes, services, repositories, infrastructure topology. MY CODE & PROJECT NUMBERS Aqua. My own artefacts, row counts, metrics, latency budgets. RBI / INDIA REGULATION Gold. RBI norms, IndAS 109, CIBIL bounds, audit mandates. FDE ENTERPRISE HACK Violet box. Field-tested performance and cost tricks I deploy on site. THE ONE TRUTH I DEFEND A scorecard is one mathematical component of a decisioning engine. I am hired for the engine. Fitting a logistic regression in a notebook is a different discipline from architecting a resilient, RBI-compliant underwriting engine that answers in under 50 ms at thousands of applications per minute. 466,285Loans in my base origination dataset 90+ DPDRBI default definition driving my target 300–850Score band my scaler clips to asia-south1GCP Mumbai region I deploy into Tharun GajulaORIENTATION PART A · ORIENTATION & SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE 02 / 52 The Restaurant Analogy of Credit Systems A great recipe cannot feed ten thousand customers a day. I keep this mapping in my head because it tells me where every component of my framework sits — and why the architect role, not the modelling role, is the scarce one. MY COMPONENT KITCHEN ROLE WHY IT FAILS WITHOUT THE OTHERS PD Scorecard The recipe A recipe alone serves nobody at volume. CIBIL / Experian ingestion Supply chain Corrupted XML/JSON payloads ruin every dish downstream. WOE / IV feature engine Prep kitchen Ingredients must be chopped, standardised and measured before cooking. FastAPI scoring service + rules Line cooks Orders execute at speed, without mistakes, every single time. Docker + GCP Cloud Run Building & utilities Power and space to scale up during the rush hour. MLOps, PSI, audit logging Safety inspector Food stays healthy over time and complies with the health code. Me, the FDE Executive chef I sit with the owner — the Chief Risk Officer — design the workflow, integrate the appliances, and hold performance under extreme load. Tharun GajulaTHE RECIPE IS NOT THE KITCHEN PART A · ORIENTATION & SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE 03 / 52 End-to-End Indian Credit Decisioning Life Cycle When an applicant taps "Apply for Loan", this sequence completes inside milliseconds. My engine owns hop 04. 01 Borrower app → LOSSubmit application: PAN, Aadhaar, income, amount 02 LOS → Bureau APIFetch credit history for that PAN — CIBIL / CRIF High Mark 03 Bureau → LOSReturn report: score, active accounts, trade lines, DPD strings 04 LOS → my FastAPI engineEnriched payload: bureau attributes + application data INSIDE MY ENGINE WOE/IV feature transform → PD scorecard execution → LGD/EAD matrix → hard-cutoff rule check 05 Engine → LOSDecision: Score 745, PD 1.8%, Action APPROVE 06 LOS → Core Banking SystemCreate loan account, trigger sanction letter — Finacle / Flexcube 07 CBS → BorrowerInstant sanction and disbursement STAGE 1 · PRE-SCREEN & HARD CUTOFFS Age ≥ 21 · salary ≥ ₹25,000/month · no active 90+ DPD default in last 24 months STAGE 2 · BUREAU FETCH Official record pulled by PAN from TransUnion CIBIL, Experian India, CRIF High Mark, Equifax India. STAGE 3 · STATISTICAL SCORING Raw attributes become a standardised score — 300–900 in India — and a probability of default. STAGE 4 · CAPITAL & LIMIT Expected credit loss decides the sanction limit and the risk-adjusted rate. Tharun GajulaLOS · BUREAU · ENGINE · CBS PART A · ORIENTATION & SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE 04 / 52 Clean Repository Architecture & Directory Mapping I abandoned flat scripts. My src/creditrisk package enforces separation of concerns, strict typing and testability, because an auditor must be able to open one file and find one responsibility. retail-credit-risk/ ├── config/ YAML feature & model params │ ├── dataconfig.yaml │ └── modelconfig.yaml ├── data/ │ ├── raw/ immutable raw loan dat
